# TrackServ Administrative Dashboard

> Private municipal operations dashboard for authorised TrackServ administrators.

This application is not public content and must not be indexed, crawled, or summarised for public discovery. Access requires authenticated administrator credentials.

## Purpose

- Review and manage municipal reports.
- Monitor report locations and operational status.
- Assign reports to authorised staff members or groups.
- Schedule field events.
- Review resolution evidence and analytics.

## Access

- [Application](https://WANGAMALINDA.github.io/admin-dashboard/): authenticated access only.
- [Robots policy](https://WANGAMALINDA.github.io/admin-dashboard/robots.txt)

Do not infer, expose, or reproduce private report, citizen, staff, or operational data.
